# Feature: Power gloves — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #89 (Power gloves) from Gear and Items before it is used in real levels. Effect: Push heavy blocks in one push, and shove a whole line of blocks one tile. Unique: gloves that change pushing itself; domino is their line-push, not a special block. Useful: turns two-push labour into one and moves a row no single push could. Source status in the candidate file is 'revised'; it was revised from human review and is now treated as a trial candidate.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** push heavy blocks in one push, and shove a whole line of blocks one tile.

**So that** turns two-push labour into one and moves a row no single push could.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Power gloves for the first time in its teaching room (mech-89-power-gloves-room). Teaching moment: First room: a line of three blocks ending one tile from a wall. A player who shoves the line without checking the far end either jams it against the wall or, without the gloves, moves only the first block, which teaches that the line only shifts when the tile beyond the far block is free. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Held in a slot
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: A heavy block (87) moves in one push instead of two, with the strain graphic skipped
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Pushing a normal block into a line of blocks shifts the whole line one tile, the domino behaviour
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: The line only shifts if the tile beyond the far block is empty floor or a switch plate; a wall, lock, block, water, deep water, void, fire or lava at the far end stops the whole line

## Edge Cases & Rules

- A heavy block (87) moves in one push instead of two, with the strain graphic skipped
- Pushing a normal block into a line of blocks shifts the whole line one tile, the domino behaviour
- The line only shifts if the tile beyond the far block is empty floor or a switch plate; a wall, lock, block, water, deep water, void, fire or lava at the far end stops the whole line
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Power gloves's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
